title: Seattle Storm Release F Kaela Davis & Activate Breanna Stewart
htmlContent:
The Seattle Storm announced today the team has released Kaela Davis from her hardship exemption contract as Breanna Stewart has been cleared to return from health and safety protocols and will be active for tonight’s game vs Chicago.

Davis was selected by the Dallas Wings with the tenth overall pick in the 2017 WNBA Draft. She spent three seasons (2017-19) with Dallas, where she averaged 6.0 points in 19.2 minutes in 33 games in her most recent season with the team (2019). In 2020, Davis was picked up by the Atlanta Dream, appearing in two games a with the Dream in Florida. She was recently signed to a training camp contract by the Chicago Sky on March 14, appearing in one game with the Sky where she recorded a rebound and assist against LA on May 6 before being waived on May 9.
